mapper.sql: c.community_id, c.community_name, c.address, c.region_id, c.longitude, c.latitude, c.house_count, c.build_year, c.walk_speed, c.description, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.price, c.avg_score, c.household, c.population, c.district_id, d.name AS districtName
mapper.select: SELECT FROM community c LEFT JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.id ORDER BY c.community_id
SELECT FROM community c LEFT JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.id WHERE c.community_id = #{communityId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community(community_name, address, region_id, longitude, latitude, location, house_count, build_year, walk_speed, description, price, avg_score, household, population, district_id) VALUES(#{communityName}, #{address}, #{regionId}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, geography::Point(#{latitude}, #{longitude}, 4326), #{houseCount}, #{buildYear}, #{walkSpeed}, #{description}, #{price}, 0, #{household}, #{population}, #{districtId})
mapper.update: UPDATE community SET community_name = #{communityName}, address = #{address}, region_id = #{regionId}, longitude = #{longitude}, latitude = #{latitude}, location = geography::Point(#{latitude}, #{longitude}, 4326), house_count = #{houseCount}, build_year = #{buildYear}, walk_speed = #{walkSpeed}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, household = #{household}, population = #{population}, district_id = #{districtId}, update_time = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE community_id = #{communityId}
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM community c LEFT JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.id
ORDER BY c.community_id OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

DECLARE @point GEOGRAPHY = geography::Point(#{lat}, #{lng}, 4326); DECLARE @buf GEOGRAPHY = @point.STBuffer(#{radiusM}); SELECT FROM community c LEFT JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.id WHERE c.location.STIntersects(@buf) = 1 ORDER BY c.community_id
SELECT FROM community c LEFT JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.id WHERE c.community_name LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%' ORDER BY c.community_id
mapper.update: UPDATE community SET avg_score = ISNULL((SELECT AVG(score) FROM [evaluation] WHERE object_type = 'community' AND object_id = #{objectId} AND status = 1), 0) WHERE community_id = #{objectId}
